verdict: S12-R1 FAIL per the frozen stop gate. The 16x batch repair made the val curve slightly flatter (best epoch 2 -> 4, gentler degradation slope) but did NOT change the fundamental shape: monotone val degradation after an early best, at a WORSE absolute value than R0. The optimizer-cadence hypothesis was tested as a single variable and rejected. Per protocol: no export, no screen, S12 closes as PARITY (R0 128-game early screen 64-64).
interpretation_note: The remaining gap to Bullet's recipe (sequential dataloader over ~100M-position datastreams vs our 780k fixed set, game-result mixing, larger hl) is out of scope for S12's one-repair budget. The epoch-2-then-degrade pattern on a 780k-position fixed dataset is consistent with rapid memorization of a small corpus rather than cadence alone.
